question: Given that ΔABC ~ ΔDEF, if BC = 12.5 cm and EF = 10 cm, then the areas of ΔABC and ΔDEF are in the ratio of:
solution:
**Given:**

ΔABC ~ ΔDEF,

If BC = 12.5 cm and EF = 10 cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b0cf8f9e32369459908813772dbffa710e6e0202f9ef218e2d388f332fbd707.png] 

According to the question ΔABC ~ ΔDEF,

Applying similarity rule

AB/DE = BC/EF = AC/DF

Then, Using formulae

Area of (ΔABC) : Area of (ΔDEF) = BC²/EF² = (12.5/10)² = 25/16

**∴ Area of (ΔABC) : Area of(ΔDEF) = 25 : 16**
